## Relationships

### [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-andrew--roger-pye.md)

John Andrew is identified as a child of [Roger Pye](../character/roger-pye.md). The two belong to the broader [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes) family, whose involvement in community affairs—such as [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) accidentally painting the local hall the wrong color—causes significant friction and turns the town's sympathy against their household.
